summary: Returns the fuel multiplier as an integer. When the dword_7D0B64 (FuelMult) flag is set, computes floor(fuelRateFactor * theoricalNumberOfLapsWithOneLitre - 0.2) via the CRT ftol conversion; otherwise returns the default value 100. On the per-frame path; called by AIAbility (0x00429470) and RacePhasePitEntryTrigger (0x00429EB0).

operations.description: If dword_7D0B64 (FuelMult flag) is non-zero, take the compute branch; otherwise take the default branch.
When dword_7D0B64 is zero, return the default fuel multiplier value 100 without computing.
Compute this[0x3984] * this[0x3448] - 0.2 (fuelRateFactor multiplied by theoricalNumberOfLapsWithOneLitre, minus a 0.2 offset) and convert the float result to int with CRT ftol.
Return the computed integer fuel multiplier.
